description: This file implements an OpenAI Speech-to-Text (STT) service class, `OpenAISTTService`, which utilizes OpenAI's transcription API to convert audio input into text. It extends the `BaseWhisperSTTService` class, providing specific configurations for the OpenAI models and handling transcription requests asynchronously.

classes.name: OpenAISTTService
classes.description: A service class that provides speech-to-text functionality using OpenAI's transcription API, supporting model selection, language specification, prompt customization, and probability metrics inclusion.
